paragraphs.source_en: The main enclosure of this castle was called Hachiman-en. Built by Hirotada’s father, it had replaced Anshō Castle, which had fallen into Oda hands, as the seat of government in Okazaki. Its stone walls stood about twenty-seven shaku high.
